The gamma function $\Gamma(z)$ is quoted for comparison in Appendix A.  In
this section $\Gamma$ is instead a real tunnelling broadening, so each
following parenthesis is a multiplicative factor.
\begin{equation}
  \Gamma(x+1)=x\Gamma(x)
\end{equation}
